title: A Fresh Morning
target_text: Early every morning, the town bazaar fills with the aroma of fresh tea and fruits. Farmers bring their harvest to market before the sun rises high.

title: Consistency in Learning
target_text: Speaking a new language requires patience and daily practice. When you speak aloud every day, your confidence grows naturally.

title: The Green Hills of Sylhet
target_text: The rolling hills are draped in endless layers of emerald tea bushes. Gentle morning mist blankets the valleys, creating a tranquil landscape.
